Quote.notes: Quote represents one revision/purchase offer set. Indicative/firm/RFQ are offer types; accepted quote never mutates to a new offer.
Quote.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.timeout: Expire each offer at carrier expiry

transitions.guard: No instant firm offer; authorized RFQ
Not accepted; risk or cover change
transitions.side_effect: Create new immutable revision; invalidate clearance

transitions.guard: Firm unexpired offer; Party grant; version and unique acceptance; required consent
transitions.side_effect: Store accepted revision and start issuance intent

transitions.guard: All purchasable offers expired by server time
All carriers definitively decline; not unknown outcomes

Underwriting Case.notes: Manual override is a new decision revision retaining prior output; material changes after terminal create a linked new case.
Underwriting Case.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: STP rule accept; authority; legal basis
Decline legally allowed; approved reason rules
Within delegated authority; reason/evidence; override flagged
transitions.side_effect: Hash decision version and required approvals

transitions.guard: Independent approval where required; unchanged hash/authority
Independent approval; lawful decline and notice

transitions.side_effect: Append review reason; keep prior decision

Policy.notes: Pending-payment/UW are issuance workflow states; payment standing is independent. Renewed is a new term/link. Cancellation may be reinstated only by a new authorized revision preserving gaps.
Policy.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: Accepted quote; valid UW; explicit carrier binding authority; payment or approved credit prerequisite
transitions.side_effect: Record immutable binding evidence and interval
transitions.timeout: Issue SLA escalation; no blind rebind

transitions.guard: Verified carrier issue result; unique external issue key
transitions.side_effect: Create policy version and document task

transitions.guard: Bound coverage interval ended even if issue evidence unresolved
transitions.side_effect: Preserve binding and unissued-document exception; expire coverage projection

transitions.guard: Coverage start reached and contract conditions valid
Term end reached before activation event processed
transitions.side_effect: Preserve issue evidence; expire interval without inventing active history

transitions.guard: Approved proposal; version lock; financial journal prerequisite

transitions.side_effect: Append lapse revision; preserve prior coverage

transitions.guard: Condition cured; authority; no forbidden retroactive gap rewrite

transitions.side_effect: Append revision with actual gap and financial effect
Append cancellation; create journaled refund obligation if due

transitions.guard: Explicit lawful reinstatement within term; new UW/version/authority
transitions.side_effect: Append new revision; preserve cancelled interval
Freeze term; independent renewal may already exist

Endorsement.notes: Financial adjustment and underwriting steps can run as separate substates; applied always appends policy revision, never edits prior cover.
Endorsement.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: Allowed change/effective date; current policy version

transitions.side_effect: Open linked UW case with pinned inputs

transitions.guard: Deterministic premium delta and tax/earning rule

transitions.side_effect: Attach decision and rerate final delta

transitions.guard: Payment/credit/refund-obligation condition per contract; policy version lock; carrier confirmation
transitions.side_effect: Append policy revision and journal-linked delta

transitions.guard: Concurrent policy revision makes proposal stale
transitions.side_effect: Invalidate approval and request new calculation

Claim.notes: Claim lifecycle is overall progress; coverage/assessment/fraud/payment/item/recovery dimensions persist independently. Closed may reopen; partial approvals and recoveries are not erased.
Claim.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: Minimal notice accepted; identity/claimant facts checked without blocking intake

transitions.timeout: Reminder/escalation; legal notice never silently expires

transitions.guard: Coverage snapshot captured; sufficient initial facts
Coverage/peril/limits verified; evidence and fraud disposition recorded
transitions.side_effect: Record item assessment and reserve revision
Hash item/payee decisions; reserve payable capacity

transitions.guard: Independent approver where required; hash/version unchanged
transitions.side_effect: Record approved/partial/rejected items and journaled obligations

transitions.guard: Approver needs evidence or disputes allocation
transitions.side_effect: Release proposed allocations only; retain history

transitions.guard: Payable items and verified payees; current allocation
transitions.side_effect: Create idempotent payout intents; lock in-flight capacity

transitions.guard: Verified payout; ledger posted; total <= payable
Remainder authorized; no overlapping uncertain attempt
All approved payable satisfied or lawful documented adjustment; journal proof
All items nonpayable; lawful reason/notice/appeal path

transitions.timeout: Recovery SLA; may outlive claim closure

transitions.guard: No unresolved payable; recovery separately tracked
transitions.side_effect: Close with evidence and customer notice

transitions.guard: Approved recovery disposition or independent ongoing recovery case
transitions.side_effect: Keep receivable separate; close claim work
Create decision revision; preserve prior paid allocations

transitions.guard: Valid claimant request; legal/reporting retention preserved
Allowed withdrawal; no undisclosed payable/outstanding dispute

Payment.notes: Capture intent state only. Refund, chargeback and payout are linked dimensions/aggregates; confirmed cannot regress to failed on old callback.
Payment.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: Allowed capture amount and obligation lock
transitions.side_effect: Submit stable capture key; retain auth evidence

transitions.timeout: Escalate unresolved outcome; never blind debit retry

transitions.guard: Verified provider effect and balanced journal committed atomically
Signature/status proof and unique effect; journal atomic commit
transitions.side_effect: Append capture journal and finalize obligation

transitions.timeout: New payment intent only if permitted

transitions.guard: Provider confirms void; no capture/unknown attempt

Refund.notes: Refund cap includes confirmed plus reserved/in-flight refunds under capture lock; unknown cannot release reservation.
Refund.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: Original capture exists; lawful reason; refundable balance available
Independent approver where required; unchanged hash
transitions.side_effect: Create refund payable journal and persist attempt

transitions.guard: Verified refund effect and journal; cap still valid
Definitive no refund effect; same obligation remains
transitions.side_effect: Keep payable; prepare safe new attempt
Record failed attempt; payable not erased

transitions.guard: Same approved amount/payee; no unresolved attempt
transitions.side_effect: Create stable next attempt per provider semantics

Settlement.notes: Batch state derives from line outcomes. Partial completion cannot repay successful lines; unknown payee/amount change invalidates approval.
Settlement.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.guard: Verified line effects and journals; unsettled remainder
Definitive failure or same-key safe query; unchanged approved lines
All lines terminal paid or documented hold/correction removed to separate batch; reconciled journals
transitions.side_effect: Publish final statement and reconciliation evidence

transitions.guard: All remaining lines resolved; no unknown payouts
No in-flight payout on changed lines; verified change

transitions.side_effect: Release batch holds into originating obligations

KYC.notes: Verified status expires or revokes; renewal is a new linked case/version. No outage equals verification success.
KYC.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.side_effect: Call scoped KYC/KYB/AML provider; retain attempt

transitions.guard: All configured checks passed with provenance
Definitive result; required human review completed
Authorized reviewer; lawful evidence and explanation

Vendor Onboarding.notes: Supports configurable participant types/capabilities; activation requires all applicable checks, not a universal insurer checklist.

transitions.guard: Definitive lawful failure after required review

transitions.side_effect: Grant only contracted capabilities and appointments

Complaint.notes: Closure is conditional on lawful notice and appeal handling. New evidence after closure opens a linked new case rather than erasing disposition.
Complaint.invalid_transitions: Every unlisted transition or failed guard returns 409 and leaves state/effects unchanged; authorization failures deny before transition.

transitions.side_effect: Send receipt and durable legal deadline
Record outcome, remedy/journal command if financial, notice

Retain full history and final notice

transitions.side_effect: Record safety actions and service capability

Atomic assignment/capacity lock; eligible provider; offer valid
